project_info.theme: Toyota Father's Day Veloz family story
project_info.color_palette: Cream paper, orange, blue, green, red, black crayon

main_subject.detail: A childlike crayon-drawing poster celebrating Father's Day. The Toyota logo sits top left. The headline reads 'CHUC MUNG NGAY CUA BO BO CHON VELOZ CON LUON VE LO' with 'Ve lo' rendered as a large blue handwritten signature-like scribble. In the center, two blue cartoon elephants smile at each other in a grassy doodle field. The smaller child elephant holds a toy-like white car, and the larger father elephant wears an orange shirt and beige shorts. The background is filled with crayon hearts, stars, flowers, and a smiling sun. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Naive crayon illustration with playful family warmth, hand-drawn texture, and children's-card sentiment

composition_elements.text: TOYOTA / CHUC MUNG NGAY CUA BO / BO CHON VELOZ / CON LUON VE LO / Move your world
items: Top Left: Toyota logo on a paper-textured cream background

Bottom Left: Hand-drawn flowers, grass, and heart doodles
Bottom Right: 'Move your world' script and floral doodles
Center/Background: Two blue crayon elephants facing each other, with the child elephant presenting a small white car to the larger father elephant

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Paper grain texture, wax-crayon stroke buildup, warm handmade charm
